svg.title: BoundaryLab: built on a Linux server, tested inside a real Android 16 Cuttlefish guest
svg.desc: Explanatory diagram from retained 30 October 2026 receipts. A Google Cloud Ubuntu 24.04.5 x86_64 n2-standard-16 host with 16 virtual CPUs, 64 GiB nominal memory and KVM compiled the pinned Android 16 r4 unchanged baseline, then a custom system_ext native-service image. The nested Cuttlefish Android 16 API 36 guest executed authorized and denied Binder calls, 61 unique native assertion cases under the separate permissive su domain, 236 harness observations including repeats, and 34 operator checks. Evidence was exported and locally hash verified before the VM and both disks were deleted.

g.text: Built on Linux. Tested inside Android.
Executed 30 Oct 2026 · explanatory diagram from retained receipts
Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS · x86_64 · n2-standard-16 · 16 vCPU / 64 GiB nominal · KVM API 12
SHA-256 archive + raw receipts + original PNGs
VM + both disks absent at 22:41:46 UTC
No retained VM, disks, snapshots or addresses
Operator-recorded evidence + local hash integrity; no independent execution attestation.
